title: Inventory planning
description: What to buy or move this week: statistical forecasts per item and location with reviewable purchase and transfer suggestions.

run.title: Run plan
run.description: Forecast demand and refresh the suggestions for one legal entity.
run.done: Plan {number} is complete with {count, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}.
run.uptodate: Plan {number} is current: nothing sold since the last run changed the picture.

list.emptyDescription: Every stocked position covers its forecast. Run the plan after selling, receiving or changing a policy.

actions.confirmed: Confirmed {count, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}.
actions.convertedOrders: Created {orders, plural, one {# purchase order} other {# purchase orders}}.
actions.convertedTransfers: Created {transfers, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}}.
actions.dismissPrompt: Why is this suggestion not being pursued?
actions.noSupplier: No supplier resolved — choose a vendor to convert.

drawer.title: {action} {quantity} {item}
drawer.advancedSummary: Method override, history window and forecast overrides
drawer.overrideSaved: The override applies from the next run.

explanation.method: {method} forecast over {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} of history.
explanation.stockouts: {count, plural, one {# stockout week} other {# stockout weeks}} excluded.

policy.title: Planning policy
policy.defaulted: Using the standard policy — set per-item values to tune it.
policy.loadFailed: Planning policy could not be loaded. Retry before changing it.
policy.integerInvalid: {field} needs a whole non-negative number. Enter a whole number or leave the field blank to use the standard value.

itemTab.title: Planning
itemTab.none: No open suggestion for this item.

report.accuracyDescription: Mean absolute percentage error and bias of past forecasts by item class.

gate.offDescription: Turn on Demand planning in Company Settings → Features to forecast stock needs.
